description: Rename the user-facing app to 'Coffee Shop' via a single APP_NAME constant in container/frontend/src/App.jsx that drives the header, document.title, and the diagram img alt; keep container/frontend/index.html <title> consistent. One obvious place so a later demo edit flips it to 'BeanThere Cafe'. Independent of all other features (frontend only). Do NOT touch container/app.py _serve_index.
steps: In container/frontend/src/App.jsx add `export const APP_NAME = 'Coffee Shop';` near the top (beside the existing `const VERSION = 'v1';`).

Replace the header literal `

☕ Coffee Ship

` with `

{`☕ ${APP_NAME}`}

`.
Add `useEffect(() => { document.title = APP_NAME; }, []);` inside App() (useEffect is already imported) so the browser tab matches APP_NAME.
Change the architecture alt from `Coffee Ship architecture diagram` to use APP_NAME: alt={`${APP_NAME} architecture diagram`}.
In container/frontend/index.html set <title>Coffee Shop</title> as the static pre-hydration fallback.
Do NOT modify container/app.py (the _serve_index degraded-mode <title>coffee-ship</title> placeholder stays as-is per design Decision 5).
acceptance_criteria: `cd container/frontend && npm install && npm run build` succeeds and produces container/frontend/dist/.
`grep -rn 'Coffee Ship' container/frontend/src container/frontend/index.html` returns no matches (only `APP_NAME = 'Coffee Shop'` remains).
APP_NAME is referenced for the header, document.title, and the img alt (single source of truth).
verification: cd container/frontend && npm install && npm run build
grep -rn "Coffee Ship" container/frontend/src container/frontend/index.html || echo 'no stray Coffee Ship (expected)'
findings:
Single source of truth for the user-facing name is `export const APP_NAME = 'Coffee Shop';` at container/frontend/src/App.jsx line 11. It drives the header (line ~202 `

{`☕ ${APP_NAME}`}

`), document.title (useEffect at line ~76), and the diagram alt (line ~209). The demo rename edit = flip that one App.jsx line from 'Coffee Shop' to 'BeanThere Cafe', AND update the static pre-hydration fallback container/frontend/index.html Coffee Shop. These are the only two frontend places the user-facing name appears. container/app.py _serve_index degraded-mode coffee-ship was intentionally left untouched (design Decision 5). Verified: npm install && npm run build succeeds, dist/ produced, grep finds no stray 'Coffee Ship', APP_NAME referenced in all three spots.
